summary: A knowledge-base category that a membership edit leaves without papers is now deleted. The owner found that after editing categories so that one held no papers, the empty category stayed. After the membership operation, every category the edit removed papers from is deleted when no saved paper belongs to it and it has no subcategory; an ancestor left empty by that deletion follows. Categories the edit did not touch (for example a newly created, still empty one) stay. Deletion re-ranks the remaining categories, drops their fold state and layout positions, and strips leftover memberships of unsaved papers. The whole edit stays one undoable '调整分类' event. Suggest-apply's existing cleanup now uses the same helper. The membership dialog says that emptied categories are deleted and can be restored with undo.
